北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 4℃。早晚温差大，记得加衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing, feels like 4℃. Big temperature swing, dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴朗，体感 5℃ 仍凉。阳光正好，出门别忘添衣！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Cixi, but feels like 5℃. Enjoy the sun, remember to add a layer!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有霾，体感 7℃。出门记得戴口罩，呵护呼吸健康哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Shanghai, feels like 7℃. Wear a mask to protect your health.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，气温 17℃。舒适宜人，但湿度有点大哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Guangzhou, 17℃. Pleasant, but with high humidity.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 16℃。阳光正好，出门记得防晒哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Shenzhen, feels like 16℃. Enjoy the sun, don't forget sunscreen!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 7℃ 偏凉。早晚注意温差，及时加减衣物。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Hangzhou, feels like 7℃. Mind the temperature changes, dress accordingly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 6℃。虽然有阳光，还是要多穿点暖和哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Nanjing, feels like 6℃. Even with sun, dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 6℃。湿度大，出门小心路滑，注意安全。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu, feels like 6℃. High humidity, be careful of slippery roads.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 6℃。能见度低，出行请注意交通安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Wuhan, feels like 6℃. Low visibility, travel safely!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 7℃，湿度低。天气干燥，记得多喝水保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, feels like 7℃. Very dry, drink water and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 9℃。能见度不高，出行注意安全哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Chongqing, feels like 9℃. Visibility is low, travel safely!
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨零下 5℃，体感 -9℃。天寒地冻，务必多穿保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -5℃, feels like -9℃. It's freezing, bundle up warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾，体感 -2℃。气温低，请注意防寒保暖，戴好口罩。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Shenyang, feels like -2℃. Cold, stay warm and wear a mask!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 13℃。紫外线较强，出门别忘防晒哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Kunming, feels like 13℃. Strong UV, remember sunscreen!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 10℃。昼夜温差大，早晚添衣很必要哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Xiamen, feels like 10℃. Big temperature swing, dress wisely.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 3℃。空气湿冷，出行注意防滑保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Qingdao, feels like 3℃. Cold and damp, watch out for slips and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，体感 1℃。气温低，请注意防寒，戴好口罩。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Dalian, feels like 1℃. Cold, stay warm and wear a mask!
